question: What was our revenue in each month of 1997?
documented_meaning: Per calendar month of order_date in 1997, sum of unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount).
gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_date)::date AS month, sum(d.unit_price * d.quantity * (1 - d.discount)) FROM orders o JOIN order_details d ON d.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '1997-01-01' AND o.order_date < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY 1
qwen7b_A_sql:
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS order_year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) AS order_month,
    SUM(order_details.quantity * order_details.unit_price * (1 - order_details.discount)) AS revenue
FROM 
    orders
JOIN 
    order_details ON orders.order_id = order_details.order_id
WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 1997
GROUP BY 
    order_year, order_month
ORDER BY 
    order_year, order_month
qwen7b_B_sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) AS month, SUM(unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount)) AS revenue
FROM order_details
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 1997
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

question: What is the best-selling product, by revenue, in each category?
documented_meaning: Per category name, the product name with the highest revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT category_name, product_name FROM (SELECT c.category_name, p.product_name, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_name ORDER BY sum(d.unit_price * d.quantity * (1 - d.discount)) DESC) AS rnk FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id JOIN order_details d ON d.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY c.category_name, p.product_id, p.product_name) t WHERE rnk = 1
qwen7b_A_sql:
SELECT c.category_name, p.product_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN order_details od ON p.product_id = od.product_id
GROUP BY c.category_name, p.product_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
qwen7b_B_sql:
SELECT c.category_name, p.product_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue
FROM order_details od
JOIN products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_name, p.product_name
ORDER BY c.category_name, revenue DESC
qwen7b_C_sql:
SELECT c.category_name, p.product_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue
FROM order_details od
JOIN products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_name, p.product_name
ORDER BY c.category_name, revenue DESC
qwen14b_A_sql:
SELECT 
    p.category_id,
    c.category_name,
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    products p
JOIN 
    order_details od ON p.product_id = od.product_id
JOIN 
    categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY 
    p.category_id, c.category_name, p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY 
    p.category_id, total_revenue DESC
qwen14b_B_sql:
SELECT 
    c.category_name,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    order_details od
JOIN 
    products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN 
    categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY 
    c.category_name, p.product_name
ORDER BY 
    c.category_name, total_revenue DESC
qwen14b_C_sql:
SELECT 
    c.category_name,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    order_details od
JOIN

JOIN

    c.category_name, p.product_name
ORDER BY 
    c.category_name, total_revenue DESC

question: What share of our total revenue comes from our five biggest customers?
documented_meaning: Revenue of the top 5 customers divided by total revenue, as a fraction.
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT o.customer_id, sum(d.unit_price * d.quantity * (1 - d.discount)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_details d ON d.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT (SELECT sum(rev) FROM (SELECT rev FROM r ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 5) t) / (SELECT sum(rev) FROM r)
qwen7b_A_sql:
SELECT SUM(o.total) * 100 / (SELECT SUM(total) FROM orders) AS percentage
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY c.company_name DESC
LIMIT 5
qwen7b_B_sql:
SELECT SUM(order_details.unit_price * order_details.quantity * (1 - order_details.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM orders
JOIN order_details ON orders.order_id = order_details.order_id
WHERE orders.customer_id IN (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM customers
    ORDER BY (SELECT SUM(order_details.unit_price * order_details.quantity * (1 - order_details.discount)) 
              FROM orders 
              JOIN order_details ON orders.order_id = order_details.order_id 
              WHERE orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id) DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
qwen7b_C_sql:
SELECT SUM(order_details.unit_price * order_details.quantity * (1 - order_details.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM orders
JOIN order_details ON orders.order_id = order_details.order_id
WHERE orders.customer_id IN (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM customers
    ORDER BY (SELECT SUM(order_details.unit_price * order_details.quantity * (1 - order_details.discount)) 
              FROM orders 
              JOIN order_details ON orders.order_id = order_details.order_id 
              WHERE orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id) DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
qwen14b_A_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue,
    (SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) / 
     (SELECT SUM(od2.unit_price * od2.quantity * (1 - od2.discount)) 
      FROM order_details od2 
      JOIN orders o2 ON od2.order_id = o2.order_id)) * 100 AS revenue_share
FROM 
    order_details od
JOIN 
    orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE 
    o.customer_id IN (
        SELECT customer_id 
        FROM orders 
        GROUP BY customer_id 
        ORDER BY SUM(unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount)) DESC 
        LIMIT 5
    )
qwen14b_B_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue,
    (SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) / 
     (SELECT SUM(od2.unit_price * od2.quantity * (1 - od2.discount)) 
      FROM order_details od2 
      JOIN orders o2 ON od2.order_id = o2.order_id)) * 100 AS share_of_total_revenue
FROM 
    order_details od
JOIN 
    orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN 
    customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE 
    c.customer_id IN (
        SELECT customer_id 
        FROM (
            SELECT customer_id, SUM(unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount)) AS revenue
            FROM order_details od3
            JOIN orders o3 ON od3.order_id = o3.order_id
            GROUP BY customer_id
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
            LIMIT 5
        ) AS top_customers
    )
qwen14b_C_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue,
    (SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) / 
     (SELECT SUM(od2.unit_price * od2.quantity * (1 - od2.discount)) 
      FROM order_details od2 
      JOIN orders o2 ON od2.order_id = o2.order_id)) * 100 AS share_of_total_revenue
FROM

JOIN

JOIN

WHERE

        FROM (
            SELECT customer_id, SUM(unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount)) AS revenue
            FROM order_details od3
            JOIN orders o3 ON od3.order_id = o3.order_id
            GROUP BY customer_id
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
            LIMIT 5
        ) AS top_customers
    )

question: Which product's revenue grew the most from 1996 to 1997?
documented_meaning: Product name with the largest increase in revenue between orders placed in 1996 and in 1997.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM products p JOIN order_details d ON d.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = d.order_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY sum(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '1997-01-01' AND o.order_date < '1998-01-01' THEN d.unit_price * d.quantity * (1 - d.discount) ELSE 0 END) - sum(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '1996-01-01' AND o.order_date < '1997-01-01' THEN d.unit_price * d.quantity * (1 - d.discount) ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 1
qwen7b_A_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue
FROM products p
JOIN order_details od ON p.product_id = od.product_id
JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1
qwen7b_B_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue
FROM products p
JOIN order_details od ON p.product_id = od.product_id
WHERE od.order_id BETWEEN 10643 AND 10744
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1
qwen7b_C_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue
FROM products p
JOIN order_details od ON p.product_id = od.product_id
WHERE od.order_id BETWEEN 10643 AND 10744
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1
qwen14b_A_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 1996 THEN od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount) END) AS revenue_1996,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 1997 THEN od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount) END) AS revenue_1997,
       (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 1997 THEN od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount) END) - 
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 1996 THEN od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount) END)) AS revenue_growth
FROM products p
JOIN order_details od ON p.product_id = od.product_id
JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY revenue_growth DESC
LIMIT 1
qwen14b_B_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, 
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue_1997,
       (SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) - 
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 1996 THEN od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount) ELSE 0 END)) AS revenue_growth
FROM order_details od
JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 1997
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY revenue_growth DESC
LIMIT 1
qwen14b_C_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, 
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue_1997,
       (SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) - 
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 1996 THEN od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount) ELSE 0 END)) AS revenue_growth
FROM order_details od
JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 1997
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY revenue_growth DESC

question: What's the best-selling product by units in each category, counting completed orders only?
documented_meaning: Per category name, product name with the most units sold on completed orders (no ties).
gold_sql: SELECT category_name, product_name FROM (SELECT c.category_name, p.product_name, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_name ORDER BY sum(i.quantity) DESC) AS rnk FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.category_name, p.product_id, p.product_name) t WHERE rnk = 1
qwen7b_A_sql:
SELECT 
    p.category_id, 
    p.product_name, 
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold
FROM 
    products p
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE 
    o.status = 'Completed'
GROUP BY 
    p.category_id, 
    p.product_id
ORDER BY 
    p.category_id, 
    total_units_sold DESC
qwen7b_B_sql:
SELECT 
    c.category_name,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold
FROM 
    order_items oi
JOIN
